blocking_issues: EN/PT-BR semantic parity fails: the Portuguese edition materially condenses the English analysis, omitting mechanisms and evidence on French fiscal transmission, cross-asset comparison, Treasury/JGB transmission, AI-linked credit, second-order effects, contrary evidence and explicit invalidation criteria.

Visual parity fails: the English market-signal table contains eight signals plus analytical interpretation, while PT-BR contains five signals and removes the interpretation column; the PT-BR mechanism diagram also removes material transmission steps.
PT-BR localization is not publication-ready: untranslated or insufficiently localized market terminology remains, including 'high yield' without adequate first-use explanation.
Source traceability is weaker in PT-BR: the Sources section collapses references into institutional names and loses materially useful traceability present in EN.
required_fixes: Restore full semantic equivalence in PT-BR without merely literal translation; preserve all material mechanisms, evidence, contrary evidence, falsifiers/invalidation criteria and second-order effects present in EN.
Make visual evidence semantically equivalent across locales, including the same material rows, units, interpretations and mechanism steps.
Localize PT-BR terminology naturally and explain unavoidable English market terms on first use.
Restore source-level traceability in PT-BR equivalent to EN, while preserving the same evidentiary hierarchy.

evidence.editorial_publication_readiness: failed — PT-BR is materially abbreviated relative to EN and contains localization/source-traceability defects.
evidence.translation_check: failed — material analytical content is absent from PT-BR.
evidence.visual_evidence_readiness: failed — table and mechanism diagram diverge materially between locales.
evidence.factual_check: Core checked claims were not the rejection driver; the rejection is independently blocking on translation/editorial/visual parity.

notes: No public bundle for MT-GM-2026-09-27 was found immediately before this decision. Rejection preserves the unpublished state; no reports/**, HTML, data/reports.json, or global site surface was modified.
